intro:
What’s wrong
with this old photo?
description:
It looks like a plain black-and-white photo… but one little detail feels completely out of place.

People, rooms and streets from another time. A quiet moment caught on camera. A clue that should not exist in that era.
If time travel is happening somewhere we know nothing about, these photos might be the evidence left behind.

Take a good look, read the scenario, and uncover the unsettling truth hidden in the image.

・Read the situation and question
・Scan the photo for something that does not belong
・Select the suspicious evidence in the image
・See the reasoning after you answer

A great pick if you’re into urban legends, mystery puzzles, light horror, solo play and quick brain-teasers.
The more the photo makes sense, the creepier the truth becomes.

Play your way, with button controls and touch controls supported.
